questions.q: Where in Setup does an admin turn on field history tracking for an object?
options: Flow Builder → Variables
Field History Tracking (via Quick Find), which lists every trackable object with a View link into each
Profiles → Field-Level Security
Object Manager → Validation Rules
questions.explain: Field History Tracking in Setup's Quick Find box opens a single page listing every trackable standard and custom object, with a View link to configure each one's tracked fields.

questions.q: How many fields can most standard and custom objects track, and what's the exception?
options: 10 fields for every object, no exceptions
5 fields for every object except Account, which allows 20
Unlimited fields for every object
Up to 20 fields for most objects; Tasks and Events are capped at 6
questions.explain: Most objects can track up to 20 fields. Tasks and Events are the exception, capped at 6 tracked fields each — a tighter limit that catches admins off guard.

questions.q: What does Field History Tracking record for a tracked standard picklist field?
options: The old value, the new value, the date and time, and which user made the change
Only that a change occurred, with no further detail
Only the new value, never the old one
A screenshot of the record before and after the change
questions.explain: For a tracked field, every edit writes the old value, new value, date/time, and the user who made the change to the object's History related list.

questions.q: Why does a multi-select picklist or long text field show up differently in the History related list than a standard picklist?
options: Those field types aren't trackable at all
They require Field Audit Trail to track at all
They only record that a change happened and who made it — not the specific old/new values, since those field types are too large to log value-by-value
They record the change twice, once for each selected value
questions.explain: Multi-select picklists and long text fields are tracked differently: Salesforce logs that a change happened and who made it, but not the specific old/new values.

questions.q: How does a user actually see a record's tracked field history?
options: By running a custom Apex trigger
By adding the object's History related list to the page layout — the tracked changes then appear automatically
By asking an admin to export a CSV from Setup every time
History is never visible to users, only to admins via Setup
questions.explain: Once fields are tracked, adding the object's History related list (e.g. Account History) to its page layout shows every qualifying change automatically, with no Apex or automation required.
